title: Understanding the Objective Function
text: The objective function Sammie is using is a mean squared error function. It measures the average of the squares of the errors, which are the differences between the observed values and the model's predictions.

title: Gradient of the Objective Function
text: The gradient of the objective function with respect to $$\theta_0$$ is given by the expression: -2/n*sum{i o1}{n}{y_i-theta_0}. This gradient helps in updating the parameter $$\theta_0$$ to minimize the error.

title: Using the Gradient Descent Update Rule
text: The update rule for $$\theta_0$$ using gradient descent is: theta_0**{(t+1)}=theta_0**{(t)}-alpha*gradient. Here, alpha is the learning rate, and the gradient is the derivative of the loss function with respect to $$\theta_0$$.

title: Calculate the Gradient
text: Calculate the gradient using the given values: $$y_1=1$$, $$y_2=2$$, theta_0**{(1)}=5, and $$n=2$$.

title: Apply the Update Rule
text: Using the calculated gradient and the update rule, find theta_0**{(0)}. Remember that $$alpha=1$$.
